scripts.dev:browser: pnpm --filter @scriptorium/contracts build && pnpm --dir app exec vite --config vite.proprium.config.ts
scripts.build:browser: pnpm --filter @scriptorium/contracts build && pnpm --dir app exec vite build --config vite.proprium.config.ts && node scripts/verify-proprium-static.mjs
scripts.verify:browser: pnpm typecheck:browser && pnpm test:browser:unit && pnpm build:browser && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: pnpm test:browser:unit && pnpm test:browser:e2e && pnpm test:browser:static:e2e && pnpm test:browser:adapters
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm test:browser:e2e && pnpm test:browser:static:e2e && pnpm test:browser:adapters
scripts.test:ui:unit: pnpm --filter @scriptorium/contracts build && pnpm --dir app exec node --import tsx --test 'src/workspace/*.test.ts' 'src/editor/cm/*.test.ts' 'src/theme.test.ts' 'src/editor.test.ts' 'src/editor/terms.test.ts' 'src/journal.test.ts' 'src/continueCandidates.test.ts'
